notes.title: Mother Machine Update 1.3
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Gremlins,

Today's update brings a long-requested feature to the game: Offline Mode! There's also support for AMD's FSR technologies to get a faster frame-rate, a new Leg-Up ability, and more - here are the full details:

[list]
[*][b]Offline Mode:[/b] You can now play Mother Machine without an internet connection! If you want to force the game to always play offline, there's a new option in the game settings. And if you can't connect to the shared Mother's Home but otherwise are online, you can still play the game and join your friends in the Caves as normal.
[*][b]Leg-Up Ability: [/b] Hold the Climb button without moving to offer a leg-up to your fellow Gremlins. They can then jump higher with your assistance!
[*][b]FSR Support:[/b] The game now supports AMD's FSR technologies, both for Upscaling and Frame Generation.  [b]New Cosmetics:[/b] There are a number of new cosmetic options and emotes to unlock.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] This update includes a number of fixes for bugs, including jerky climbing, unwanted falling off ropes, getting stuck in the floor, and many more.
[/list]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/f28a4cd19ea31ac5689f915e4fca8861d3ca609e.gif"][/img]The team at Maschinen-Mensch wants to thank all of you wonderful Gremlins who have been enjoying the game since we launched it earler this year. If you've been having fun in the caves, a Steam review would mean the world to us - it's how other Gremlins find their way to Mother Machine![/p]

tags.feature: Offline Mode: You can now play Mother Machine without an internet connection! If you want to force the game to always play offline, there's a new option in the game settings. And if you can't connect to the shared Mother's Home but otherwise are online, you can still play the game and join your friends in the Caves as normal.
Leg-Up Ability: Hold the Climb button without moving to offer a leg-up to your fellow Gremlins. They can then jump higher with your assistance!
FSR Support: The game now supports AMD's FSR technologies, both for Upscaling and Frame Generation.
New Cosmetics: There are a number of new cosmetic options and emotes to unlock.

notes.title: Mother Machine Update 1.2 (Creators' Ruins Update)
notes.content:
As well as the new Creators' Ruins Biome (plus 10 new mutations!), this update has a number of bug fixes and other changes. In particular, we've made some big improvements to the performance of the game which should now run at a higher framerate, both on lower spec machines and those with the newest GPUs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/dc79db6f1d1fe887ba1ecb175010b0e7c0fe4769.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list][*]Added the Creators' Ruins Biome ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1555980/view/643565300586911072]click here for more details[/url])
[*]Added new Platforms to start Creators' Ruins expeditions in the bottom of Mother's Home
[*]Added 10 new Mutations unlockable with Radberries found in Creators' Ruins
[*]Steam Remote Play Together is now supported (if you have problems, try running the game in Fullscreen mode, not Windowed Fullscreen)[/list]
[h2]CHANGED[/h2]
[list][*]The Adventures "TOTAL EXTRACTION" and "THE SECRET PLAN" now take place in the Creators' Ruins
[*]The devices that provide rewards when a battery is inserted now have a new look
[*]Airlocks now have two reward options to choose from (but still only one battery)
[*]Expedition types you haven't yet unlocked can still be played via the Quick Play terminal
[*]Defeating a boss will now display a notification for all players[/list]
[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list][*]More optimizations: CPU, GPU, and reduced Disk Space usage
[*]Fixed issues when joining caves that were very recently started or finished
[*]Fixed friend invitations not working sometimes
[*]Fixed various input issues in Splitscreen when the setting "P1 Uses Keyboard" is on
[*]When doing a pullup to a narrow ledge, you no longer fall off the other side
[*]Fixed getting multiple "Objective Complete" notifications when only one objective was completed
[*]Fixed various situations where you would be unable to move or perform actions
[*]Fixed issues where the wrong interaction would be triggered while you were holding an item[/list]

notes.title: New FREE DLC Incoming: The Creators' Ruins!
notes.content:
Being the chaotic gremlins we are, we're thrilled to announce a huge, lifetime-free Biome DLC for your ultimate enjoyment! Gather your friends and prepare for mayhem: the Creators' Ruins are waiting to be explored (and most likely wrecked) by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/09ad11e9a0489b32508224c519c84ad2ef4c9a98.jpg[/img]

The Creators' Ruins seamlessly extends the base game of Mother Machine with an array of exciting new features:

[h2]10 New Mutations[/h2]
Unlock even more special Mutations to expand your gameplay abilities! Steal health with the Vampire Attack, or morph into a ball to roll through the caves, allowing your siblings to carry and throw you around. Become the ninja gremlin you always dreamed of with the Chameleon Skin, or unleash electric shockwaves with a well-timed fart. And many more!

[h2]Elektro Chomper Boss[/h2]
Brace yourself for thrilling new boss encounters against the colossal Elektro Chomper. Beware of its powerful electric attacks—they are shockingly effective!

[h2]Rogue Drones[/h2]
Ancient Colonist Technology remains active within the Ruins, and unfortunately, it decided that you are a trespasser! Prepare for a constant barrage of hostile Rogue Drones.

[h2]Mini Hoppers[/h2]
A new breed of miniature Mini Hoppers has been spotted in the Creators' Ruins Biome. While not dangerous individually, they appear in massive groups and will surely create pure chaos with their frenetic jumping behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/68c6f3bc236ab6d0f267c65aefb11ff5564d16dd.gif[/img]

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We can't wait for you to dive into the Creators' Ruins and experience all the new chaos! What part of this update are you most excited to try first?

notes.title: Mother Machine Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Gremlins![/h2]

Today's update adds support for [b]DLSS technologies[/b] and also gives you more control over how some of the graphics options behave. We know many of you woud like the game to run at a higher frame-rate, and this is just the first step to making that happen. We are focusing on optimizing the game, both in terms of rendering performance and also the overhead of managing everything that's going on in the cave for devices with less powerful CPUs (looking at you, Steam Deck!).

There are also a few tuning changes and of course bug fixes in this update. We've seen that the platform next to Mother (we call it the Quick Play Platform) can be a bit confusing for new players, and we have some larger changes in the works for improving how you get into caves quickly. In the meantime though, we've changed the display above the platform to show the player count, to make it clearer you are joining a cave that has other players in it. We've also added a way of [b]inviting friends into caves with a single press[/b], with a new button in the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/613068eb21419efd8a6ddb518f27633edef023bd.png[/img]

Don't forget that the [b]Misty Grove DLC is free[/b] for another week! It gives you access to a whole new Biome with different creatures, a new Boss, and 10 unique mutations to unlock. If you own it, Mother will give you a little introduction next time you visit her Home - and if not, the game will now remind you to claim it for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3357220/Mother_Machine__Misty_Grove/

We have much more planned for Mother Machine (including new content!), but our focus right now is improving performance and fixing more bugs, so expect more updates in the coming weeks! In the meantime, if you've been enjoying the game, please do [b]leave a review on Steam[/b]. Now, on to the full details:

[h1]Full Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[list][*]Added options for controlling the upscaling method and amount of upscaling:
  [b]Auto[/b]: Will select the based option based on your hardware and Graphics mode
  [b]Built-In[/b]: Uses Unreal's upscaling method. You can select the percentage of upscaling, or turn it off completely.
  [b]DLSS-SR[/b] (requires NVIDIA RTX GPU): Uses NVDIA's Deep Learning Super Sampling - Super Resolution method. You can control the amount of upscaling from DLAA (no upscaling, AA only) to UltraPerformance (maximum upscaling)
  [b]NVIDIA NIS[/b]: Uses NVIDIA Imagine Scaling method. This is compatible with non-NVIDIA GPUs. You can control the amount of upscaling from UltraQuality (minimum upscaling) to Performance (maximum upscaling)  
[*]Added support for [b]DLSS Frame Generation[/b] technologies (requires NVIDIA RTX 40 series or better GPU). You can control the amount of frame generation based on what your hardware supports, or turn it off.
[*]Added support for limiting the frame rate. You can choose 30, 60 or Unlimited.
[*]Added a quick way to invite a friend into a cave: look in the top-left of the screen to see how. Note this only appears when the cave isn't full!
[*]Mother will now give you an introduction to the Misty Grove if you have the DLC. If you don't have the DLC, it's free! The game will also remind you to claim it.[/list]
[h2]CHANGED[/h2]
[list][*]Tutorial: Removed the laser gate
[*]Tutorial: added an automatically created portal if you don't do it
[*]Tutorial: When Mother tells you to step on the plate, you stop to listen
[*]The Sinister Sister: Added more crystals & food
[*]Map: Increased the radius of the "hint" map area as you explore
[*]Cave Harvest: improved textures on the Shredder
[*]Perk Pills that you get from Boxes now display their perk description when you are near them
[*]You can now access Custom Expeditions immediately after finishing the tutorial
[*]The Quick Play platform (the one by Mother) now displays the number of players in the cave instead of the Exploration %[/list]
[h2]FIXED[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed trampoline platforms sometimes being hard to get on (or them throwing you off)
[*]Fixed Balloons sometimes getting stuck in the walls
[*]Fixed Portals not working sometimes
[*]Fixed some issues with spectating other players
[*]Fixed getting stuck when doing an emote while going through a door
[*]Fixed Gentle Giant showing acid splashes when not in acid
[*]Fixed Drown in Acid achievement not properly unlocking
[*]Fixed large creatures not moving sometimes
[*]Fixed the death sound playing when players leave Mother's Home
[*]Fixed caves generating sometimes with battery-powered beam gates that you might not have a battery for
[*]We're still looking into the crash some players experience when accessing the mutations menu. In the meantime, you can use the Launch Option "-DisableMediaPlayer" to prevent the crash.[/list]

notes.title: Mother Machine Demo Update 2

Mother Machine's launch is less than 2 weeks away! The team has been hard at work getting the final version ready, and today we're updating the Demo with the new goodies.

[*]Lots of bug fixes

[*]Lots of graphical and audio polish
[/list]

There will be more to come, including more performance updates and missing/improved translations.

For more gremlin news, don't forget to follow our socials and [url=https://discord.gg/maschinen-mensch]join our discord[/url]!

notes.title: Mother Machine Demo & Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.content:
Hello gremlins,

[h2]Couch Co-Op Fest has officially started! Grab a friend and jump into our Mother Machine splitscreen demo right now![/h2]

We've made a lot of changes since the last time you got your gremlin claws on the game.
The demo includes the first chapter of Mother Machine's story with a completely revamped UI, updated graphics, voiceover for Mother and more!

Our splitscreen demo will allow you and a friend to play on the same PC - either on the couch or at a desk. How delightfully old-school!

[b]Keep in mind the demo is splitscreen only; the online coop demo will be out during Steam Next Fest (February 24th to March 3rd).[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/fc6ce3477b325e150d94024edd767900c9eb69bc.png[/img]

In other news, we've also been streaming gameplay and gamedev insights regularly on our Twitch channel - including our first look at the splitscreen version of Mother Machine last week! Curious to see more? [url=http://twitch.tv/maschinenmenschlive]Then give us a follow[/url] and don't miss the next stream!

Finally, you can always chat with us about Mother Machine, other Maschinen-Mensch games, gamedev stuff and more on our Discord server! [url=https://discord.gg/maschinen-mensch]Come join the chaos[/url].

See you in the caves - Mother welcomes her children once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146113/005504fce9fbcec4074b3c4e12685ce137a51710.png[/img]

notes.title: Mother Machine Open Beta Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello gremlins,

It's time once again to cause chaos - Mother has allowed us another playtest! ːsteamhappyː

[b]From Friday, November 22nd to Monday, November 25th you and your friends will be able to hop into the game and be your most chaotic self.[/b]

Within the playtest you will be able to see our updated hub and meet Mother once again. Venture into the depths of the alien cave network, complete missions, and come back to evolve and change your playstyle (or keep the same mutations, I'm not the boss of you!)

Keen observers from our first playtest will see some changes, including: 
[list]
[*] Mouse & keyboard support
[*] Improvements on the UI with new animations and updated icons
[*] New chaos gremlin animations (go on and say what you really mean!)
[*] Foliage looks more foliagey (it's true)
[*] Reward plants look even cooler now (very shiny!)
[*] The map got various UX improvements
[/list]

Anyone can join in and we can't wait to hear your feedback on this new version!

Go on and sign up to the playtest now - it will please Mother...
